document_title: Publication of Venezuela Sanctions Regulations Web General Licenses 47, 48, 49, and 50

claims.quote: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this general license, all transactions prohibited by the Venezuela Sanctions Regulations, 31 CFR part 591 (the VSR), including those involving the Government of Venezuela, Petr[oacute]leos de Venezuela, S.A. (PdVSA), or any entity in which PdVSA owns, directly or indirectly, a 50 percent or greater interest (collectively, ``PdVSA Entities''), that are ordinarily incident and necessary to the exportation, reexportation, sale, resale, supply, storage, marketing, delivery, or transportation of U.S.-origin diluents to Venezuela are authorized, provided that any contract for such transactions with the Government of Venezuela, PdVSA, or PdVSA Entities specify that the laws of the United States or any jurisdiction within the United States govern the contract and that any dispute resolution under the contract occur in the United States.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with the Government of Venezuela, PdVSA, or PdVSA Entities
claims.summary: Parties must ensure that contracts for transactions involving the Government of Venezuela, PdVSA, or PdVSA Entities specify that U.S. laws govern the contract and that dispute resolution occurs in the United States.

claims.quote: Note 1 to Paragraph (a). Transactions authorized by paragraph (a) include processing of payments, arranging shipping and logistics services, including chartering vessels, obtaining marine insurance and protection and indemnity (P&I) coverage, and arranging port and terminal services, including with port authorities or terminal operators that are part of the Government of Venezuela.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with the Government of Venezuela, PdVSA, or PdVSA Entities
claims.summary: Parties must include services such as processing payments, arranging shipping and logistics, chartering vessels, obtaining marine insurance and P&I coverage, and arranging port and terminal services with port authorities or terminal operators that are part of the Government of Venezuela.

claims.quote: (1) Payment terms that are not commercially reasonable, involve debt swaps or payments in gold, or are denominated in digital currency, digital coin, or digital tokens issued by, for, or on behalf of the Government of Venezuela, including the petro;
claims.affected_party: any party
claims.summary: Payment terms that are not commercially reasonable, involve debt swaps or payments in gold, or are denominated in digital currency, digital coin, or digital tokens issued by, for, or on behalf of the Government of Venezuela, including the petro, are prohibited.

claims.quote: (2) Any transaction involving a person located in or organized under the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Republic of Cuba, or any entity that is owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by or in a joint venture with such persons;
claims.affected_party: any party
claims.summary: Any transaction involving a person located in or organized under the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Republic of Cuba, or any entity that is owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by or in a joint venture with such persons is prohibited.

claims.quote: (3) The unblocking of any property blocked pursuant to the VSR, except as provided in paragraph (a); or
claims.affected_party: any party
claims.summary: The unblocking of any property blocked pursuant to the VSR, except as provided in paragraph (a), is prohibited.

claims.quote: (4) Any transaction involving a blocked vessel.
claims.affected_party: any party
claims.summary: Any transaction involving a blocked vessel is prohibited.

claims.quote: (c) Any person that exports, reexports, sells, resells, or supplies U.S.-origin diluents to Venezuela pursuant to this general license must provide a detailed report to [email protected] and [email protected] that identifies, for each of these transactions: (1) The parties involved; (2) The quantities and values; and (3) The dates the transactions occurred.
claims.affected_party: any person that exports, reexports, sells, resells, or supplies U.S.-origin diluents to Venezuela
claims.summary: Any person that exports, reexports, sells, resells, or supplies U.S.-origin diluents to Venezuela pursuant to this general license must provide a detailed report to the specified email addresses that identifies, for each of these transactions: the parties involved, the quantities and values, and the dates the transactions occurred.

claims.quote: (d) Reports described in paragraph (c) are due ten days after the execution of the first of such transactions and every 90 days thereafter while such transactions are ongoing.

claims.summary: Reports described in paragraph (c) are due ten days after the execution of the first of such transactions and every 90 days thereafter while such transactions are ongoing.

claims.quote: (c) Any person that exports, reexports, sells, resells, or supplies goods, technology, software, or services pursuant to this general license must provide a detailed report to [email protected] and [email protected] that identifies, for each of these transactions: (1) The parties involved; (2) The goods, technology, software, or services involved, including quantities and values; (3) The dates the transactions occurred; and (4) Any taxes, fees, or other payments provided to the Government of Venezuela.
claims.affected_party: any person
claims.summary: Any person that exports, reexports, sells, resells, or supplies goods, technology, software, or services pursuant to this general license must provide a detailed report to the specified email addresses with information on the parties involved, goods involved, transaction dates, and any taxes, fees, or other payments provided to the Government of Venezuela.

claims.quote: all transactions prohibited by the Venezuela Sanctions Regulations, 31 CFR part 591 (the VSR), including those involving the Government of Venezuela, Petr[oacute]leos de Venezuela, S.A. (PdVSA), or any entity in which PdVSA owns, directly or indirectly, a 50 percent or greater interest, that are related to the negotiation of and entry into contingent contracts for new investment in oil or gas sector operations in Venezuela are authorized, provided that the performance of any such contract is made expressly contingent upon separate authorization from the Office of Foreign Assets Control (``contingent contracts'').
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with Venezuela, PdVSA, or PdVSA Entities
claims.summary: Parties must negotiate and enter into contingent contracts for new investment in oil or gas sector operations in Venezuela, provided that the performance of such contracts is contingent upon separate authorization from OFAC.

claims.quote: the term ``contingent contracts'' includes executory contracts, executory pro forma invoices, agreements in principle, executory offers capable of acceptance such as bids or proposals in response to public tenders, binding memoranda of understanding, or any other similar agreement.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with Venezuela, PdVSA, or PdVSA Entities
claims.summary: Parties must recognize that contingent contracts include executory contracts, pro forma invoices, agreements in principle, and other similar agreements.

claims.quote: Paragraph (a) authorizes negotiating and entering into contingent contracts to engage in new oil or gas exploration, development, or production activities in Venezuela, expand existing operations in Venezuela, and to form new joint ventures or other entities in Venezuela related to the foregoing activities. Transactions authorized by paragraph (a) also include prefatory steps for such activities, such as conducting commercial, legal, technical, safety, and environmental due diligence and assessments.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with Venezuela, PdVSA, or PdVSA Entities
claims.summary: Parties must negotiate and enter into contingent contracts to engage in new oil or gas exploration, development, or production activities in Venezuela, expand existing operations, and form new joint ventures, including prefatory steps such as due diligence.

claims.quote: This general license does not authorize: (1) Any transaction involving a person located in the Russian Federation, the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Republic of Cuba, the People's Republic of China, or any entity that is owned or controlled by or in a joint venture with such persons;
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with persons located in specified countries or entities controlled by them
claims.summary: Parties must not engage in transactions involving persons located in the Russian Federation, the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Republic of Cuba, the People's Republic of China, or entities owned or controlled by them.

claims.quote: The unblocking of any property blocked pursuant to the VSR; or
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with blocked property
claims.summary: Parties must not unblock any property blocked pursuant to the VSR.

claims.quote: Any transaction involving a blocked vessel.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with blocked vessels

claims.quote: Nothing in this general license relieves any person from compliance with the requirements of other Federal agencies, including the Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security.
claims.affected_party: all persons

claims.quote: (2) Any monetary payment to a blocked person, excluding payments for local taxes, permits, or fees, is made into the Foreign Government Deposit Funds, as specified in Executive Order 14373 of January 9, 2026, or any other account as instructed by the U.S. Department of the Treasury.
claims.affected_party: parties making monetary payments to blocked persons
claims.summary: Parties must make any monetary payment to a blocked person (excluding payments for local taxes, permits, or fees) into the Foreign Government Deposit Funds or any other account as instructed by the U.S. Department of the Treasury.

claims.quote: Any payments of oil or gas taxes or royalties to the Government of Venezuela, PdVSA, or any PdVSA Entity must be paid into the Foreign Government Deposit Funds or any other account as instructed by the U.S. Department of the Treasury.
claims.affected_party: any party making payments to the Government of Venezuela, PdVSA, or any PdVSA Entity
claims.summary: Payments of oil or gas taxes or royalties to the Government of Venezuela, PdVSA, or any PdVSA Entity must be paid into the Foreign Government Deposit Funds or any other account as instructed by the U.S. Department of the Treasury.
